description: Prepare redeeming Midnight lend credit for loan tokens, limited to what the market can pay out now. First call `morpho_midnight_get_user_position` for the credit. Before maturity a market with a continuous fee leaves some credit; redeem again after maturity. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Credit units to redeem, in loan token decimals. Omit to redeem the full face value.

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_redeem
